candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.area.adc_area_um2: physical ADC/readout area for the claimed object
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.area.dac_area_um2: physical DAC/row-drive area for the claimed object
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.break_even_rerun.rerun_artifact: break-even rerun produced from the same measured values
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.energy.adc_energy_per_conversion: supply-current integration for the readout decision, not only pin capacitance
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.energy.dac_energy_per_row_drive: supply-current integration for the row-drive event, not only pin capacitance
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.extraction.extracted_netlist: one complete extracted netlist for the claimed converter/readout object
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.latency.conversion_time_ns: full readout decision time, not only row RC settling
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.noise.input_referred_noise: input-referred readout noise for the same run
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.noise.output_noise_rms: measured or simulated output noise at the digital code boundary
candidate_payload_terms_still_missing.simulation.model_files: same-run model/setup file for the claimed converter/readout object

claim_boundary.allowed: collects the strongest local starter measurements into one first-candidate packet and names exactly which strict payload fields remain unsupported
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not fill the canonical candidate payload, does not write accepted post-layout evidence, and does not prove a 10-bit DAC, 12-bit ADC, comparator noise, DRC/LVS, or replacement economics

latency.run_id must not be a placeholder
